# BulletChartOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`BulletChart`](bullet-chart.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type BulletChartOptions = ChartBaseOptions & Partial<Omit<Pick<BulletChart, (typeof BULLET_CHART_OWN_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'measureColor' | 'targetColor'>> & {
    /** Fill colour of the primary measure bar. */
    measureColor?: ColorInput;
    /** Fill colour of the comparative target marker. */
    targetColor?: ColorInput;
}
```

- [`altText`](#alttext): Alternate text used when the document is generated as PDF/UA-1.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.
